sources.entry: Expensave - Expense tracker for personal and family budget management. Track spending on a shared calendar, import bank statements and monitor finances with reports. GPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Expensave is a free, self-hosted expense tracker for personal and family budgets that supports shared calendars, bank statement import, and spending reports.
summary.what_it_does: Expensave lets multiple users track spending and income on shared expense calendars, including unlimited calendars and recurring entries on daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly schedules. It can import bank statements in OFX/QFX, ISO 20022 camt.053 XML (versions .001.02–.001.08), Revolut CSV, and Dollarbird CSV formats. It provides reports on spending and income habits, with light and dark themes. A built-in MCP server at /_mcp lets AI assistants add, update, and delete expenses and generate reports using the same permissions as the web app. It is a responsive web app that can be installed as a PWA on iOS and Android.
use_cases: import bank statements into a budget tracker
share an expense calendar with family members
manage expenses through an AI assistant
how_to_run: curl -fsSL -o docker-compose.yml <compose file URL from README>
Create a .env file with TZ, LOCALE, and REGISTRATION_DISABLED settings
Alternatively, run the automated installer: curl -fsSL <installer URL> | sudo bash (requires Docker)
notable: Built-in MCP server so AI assistants such as Claude, Cursor, or pi can manage expenses
Imports SEPA camt.053 ISO 20022 XML statements from European banks and OFX/QFX from US banks
Installable mobile PWA without an app store
Automated interactive installer that generates a database password and detects timezone and locale
caveats: Requires Docker for both install options
Developed and maintained in the author's free time, per the README
Bank import format support is limited to the listed formats; detailed export instructions are in the external wiki
